name: Auware
summary: AI-built, audience-specific Shopify pages: automatically generates a personalized page per buyer persona — not just landing pages but advertorials, listicles, comparison and product (PDP) pages — with targeted headlines, social proof and FAQs, plus per-segment analytics. Built to lift ad conversion for DTC brands. No code.
best_for: Shopify stores running segmented paid campaigns (different personas, interests, offers) who are currently sending all that traffic to one generic page
skip_if: you're not on Shopify, you don't run audience-segmented paid ads, or you just want a flexible general-purpose page builder
honest_knock: It's deliberately narrow — Shopify-only and built around segmented paid traffic. If you send everyone to one page or don't run audience-segmented ads, the core 'a page per persona' value doesn't really kick in. It's also newer and less battle-tested than general builders like PageFly.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 28 September 2026 on auware.com/pricing and the Shopify App Store listing) One plan: Pro at $199 a month per store, where a store is one myshopify.com domain, so each store needs its own subscription. It includes a 30-day free trial, 10 active campaigns and 6 personalized audience pages per product. Influencer Pages is a $99-a-month add-on. Larger setups — unlimited stores and team members, custom campaign and audience limits, Shopify Plus — are a 'Contact Us' conversation with no published price. The Shopify listing shows the same $199 a month, charged in USD and billed every 30 days. Correction: until 28 September 2026 this field put the plan at $99 a month; $99 is the Influencer Pages add-on, and the plan was already $199 when we read the pricing page on 26 July 2026.
